what_works: Full-bleed vintage product photography paired with a black-and-yellow heritage palette — the site reads as 'we've been doing this for decades' without saying it. Hero CTAs overlay imagery without dimming it.
what_does_not_translate: Multi-product-line nav (apparel + vehicles + EVs) is irrelevant for a single-trade contractor — strip to one CTA path.
type_observations: Modern geometric sans against vintage crest/badge artwork — typographic anchor stays clean while imagery does the heritage work.
